faults.title: Closing, a figure dock's seat in its row takes the open tray's width until the morph settles
At 390 the widened seat wraps the row: the dock jumps up, the key and the figure jump down, then snap back
An end-anchored figure dock slides its resting seats (Table, Enlarge) sideways by the tray's width as it opens and closes
The scene stage's dock (sticky head) opens in the page's flow: its seat widens by the tray's width while open
The rail's crest slides right and down as the rail opens, and back as it closes
The rail's close lands the disc, holds the crest off its rest, then snaps it in the settle frame
A press on the rail's disc follows the home link: the rail swaps for the homepage's open rail
Every figure dock's close ends with a settle frame about 280 ms after the plate stopped
The theme toggle shrinks under a press; its centre holds
A pressed dock control squashes, more in height than in width; the dock's box holds
A long frame swallows part of a close: one frame carries tens of pixels of the plate's width
